bullets: Served as the primary client interface for 9 enterprise clients across regulated UK and German wealth-management markets; ran discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews to uncover intent behind feature requests and translate it into structured technical requirements.

Authored 500+ functional specifications, 100+ Agile user stories and developer-ready PRDs with zero ambiguity; contributed to API specifications and system-integration documentation for third-party services.

Coordinated end-to-end system integration testing (SIT) and UAT with clients across UK pensions, tax, ISA and GIA portfolios and cross-device platforms, ensuring every delivered product met business requirements and passed acceptance sign-off.
Conducted gap analysis between current product capabilities and evolving client needs; proposed technical workarounds and new features that were formally adopted into the global product roadmap.

Wrote complex SQL (joins, subqueries, window functions) for ad-hoc analysis and built automated Power BI, JIRA and Excel dashboards, improving visibility of release cycles and operational efficiency across teams in 3 countries.

Re-mapped 50+ user stories from a UK project onto the German Goldberry programme, cutting duplicate analysis and protecting an at-risk market-entry deadline; maintained version-controlled business rules in Confluence.
